_doc: Hauz-Pay weekly import rules. roster = M-Pesa phone -> staff name (routed to the Wages register as casual wage). known_payees = phone -> {cat,label} for recurring non-wage payments auto-categorised to a voucher column. Everything else lands as a voucher in 'OT' (Other) and is FLAGGED for Tanuj to categorise in the editor. Cats: TG TE SE OA FD GP OT.
_topup_banks_doc: Money IN rows are wallet top-ups: posted to ERPNext only (Dr Hauz-Pay Wallet - VCL, Cr the bank), never to QuickBooks. Each rule maps a pattern (case-insensitive substring of the statement's name + narration + payee + method; a string or a list) to the ERPNext BANK account credited. First match wins. No match = the line is flagged 'bank?' for Tanuj to pick. Account must be a live account_type=Bank account of Vimit Converters Limited or the import treats it as no match.
_keyword_doc: Matched (case-insensitive substring) against narration + name + payee for payments whose phone isn't in roster/known_payees. First match wins; checked before the flag-as-Other fallback. Use for payees whose category is fixed by what's bought, not who's paid (e.g. Tony Oyoda's phone covers both UCR=Other and TREO=unknown).
